title: pkpdsim: building blocks of physiologically based pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic models in SBML

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
pkpdsim is a library for physiologically based pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) models in SBML: a standard physiology at its centre, the substances, chemistry, routes and observers of a model on top of it, and the simulation experiments, fits, scans, uncertainty and credibility of sbmlsim on top of those. The source code is available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/pkpdsim.

The physiology, the centre of the library

  • the organs of ICRP 89 with their volumes, blood flows and blood, scaled to the individual of a study, and the physiology of the rat, the mouse and the pig
  • virtual populations, and impaired liver, kidney and cardiac function by the clinical classes the studies report
  • pregnancy with the fetoplacental unit, circadian rhythms and the adipose tissue of an individual
  • the standard organ of every organ and the variants within its boundary: the zonated liver, the nephron kidney, the intestines
  • the zonated liver of n zones with flow and diffusion along the sinusoid, and the circuit of an ex vivo machine perfusion with one mounted organ

The building blocks a model puts on top of it

  • the mechanism flags of a substance (binding, erythrocytes, distribution, excretion, inhibition, induction) and the processes of an organ with the proteins which carry them
  • the routes, the lumen segments with their dissolution and absorption, the bile and the enterohepatic circulation
  • the observers a model is read at, and the SBO, PBPKO, UBERON, NCIT, UniProt and ChEBI terms of every created element
  • the figures of a model, generated from its definition
  • the parameter database, every number with the publication it is taken from

The analysis, the capabilities of sbmlsim in the PBPK context

  • the published studies of a model as simulation experiments, with the shared vocabulary of the metadata of their fit mappings
  • the fits, their uncertainty in the SBML and the bands of a run over their draws
  • the scans and the sensitivity analyses of the PK observables
  • the contexts of use of a model and the assessment of its credibility
  • the commands which work with every model package, and the release of a model as a repository of its own

The documentation is available on https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/pkpdsim.
